name: auto-apply
description: A local helper that applies to LinkedIn jobs with your resume, in a browser you can see.

scripts.resumes: mkdir -p resumes && .venv/bin/python scripts/build-docx.py && libreoffice --headless --convert-to pdf --outdir resumes resumes/*.docx
scripts.setup: npm install && npx playwright install chromium && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -q python-docx
